HERO OBJECT — four takes on a cube / voxel form for the hero (and the final CTA).
All use the CraftWare palette on near-black, slow rotation + cursor parallax in code.

1 Rubik, aligned — iconic, premium, instantly a cube. Safe.
2 Rubik, mid-solve — a layer turning: motion + progress. Busier.
3 Voxel C — the C built from glass blocks, a few drifting off. On the name ("craft"). Needs the C to read cleaner.
4 Fractured cube — a 3x3x3 with pieces pulled out and floating: a system assembling. Most abstract.

Tell me the number; I build it into the Homepage hero and the live site.

CRAFTWARE — FINALIZED DESIGN
Dark, cinematic, restrained. Space Grotesk (display) + Geist (body). Violet #8B5CF6 → cyan #22D3EE used sparingly on near-black #08080B. One recurring signature object in the hero + final CTA (see the 'Hero object' page).

HERO A/B — composition:
• A (leading) — object centred, headline over its lower third. Calm, premium.
• B — object pushed right, headline large on the left. More overtly digital.

Motion (built in code): Lenis smooth scroll · headline mask-reveal line by line · object slow rotation + mouse parallax · Services row hover expands type + blooms glow + floats keyword tags · Work: vertical scroll drives the rail horizontally, centre panel scales · Process: gradient line draws left-to-right on scroll · Case study: metrics count up on enter.
